attractions: Speedboat or seaplane transfer [scenic island journey]
tips: Seaplane more scenic but expensive alternative
Settle in and relax first day

days.title: House Reef & Water Sports
tips: Early morning snorkeling quietest and most fish active
Kayaking peaceful island exploration

days.title: Diving Certification Course
attractions: PADI Open Water certification [beginner diving course]
tips: 3-4 day course; intensive but rewarding
Maldives excellent diving destination

days.title: Continue Diving & Exploration
tips: Multiple dives enhance underwater experience
Dolphins often spotted at sunset

days.title: Island Excursion & Transfer
tips: Book excursions day before
Second resort offers different experience

days.title: Second Resort Settling
attractions: House reef snorkeling [new reef to explore]
tips: Second resort different vibe; enjoy contrasts
Each resort has unique character

days.title: Advanced Diving & Water Activities
tips: Advanced diving requires additional training
Water sports add excitement to relaxation

days.title: Second Resort Excursions
attractions: Different speedboat excursion [different reefs and islands]
tips: Different reefs have different fish and coral
Village visits support local economy

days.title: Relaxation & Spa Day
tips: Spa day rejuvenating after diving activities
Couples treatments available for honeymooners

days.title: Departure & Reflection
tips: Morning departure usually requires late night speedboat
Paradise experience to treasure lifelong
